notablePrerequisites:
Najeela and Tanuki Transplanter do not have summoning sickness.
Tanuki Transplanter has power 5 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
description:
Declare Tanuki Transplanter and Najeela as attackers.
Tanuki Transplanter and Najeela trigger.
Resolve the Tanuki Transplanter trigger, adding at least {5}.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Najeela by paying {5}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
